basic_details.job_title: OPSC Assistant Section Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 340 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Odisha Public Service Commission (OPSC), Kataka, has invited applications for 340 posts of Assistant Section Officer (Group-B) under Advt No. 15 OF 2026-27. The online application is open from 9 November 2026 to 30 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online mode while filling the Online Application Form.

age_limit.age_details: Must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years (as on 1 January 2026)

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or equivalent, with adequate knowledge in Computer Application as specified in the Schedule. Candidates must also be able to speak, read and write Odia and meet the prescribed Odia qualification.
qualification.details: Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or such other qualification equivalent thereto; Adequate knowledge in Computer Application as specified in the Schedule; Ability to speak, read and write Odia, with one of the prescribed Odia qualifications Age limit: Must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: SEBC 5 years, SC 5 years, ST 5 years, Women 5 years, Ex-Servicemen 5 years, PwD (40% or more) 10 years, PwD of SEBC/SC/ST 15 years (cumulative) | Other conditions: | Must be able to speak, read and write Odia with one of the prescribed Odia qualifications Adequate knowledge in Computer Application as specified in the Schedule Transgender candidates can apply Date of birth in the High School Certificate or equivalent only is accepted

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 35,400 in Level-9, Cell-1 of the ORSP Rules, 2017 Pay Matrix, plus DA and other allowances

pattern_table.Part / Paper: Written Examination (Paper I, II and III)
pattern_table.Subject: Paper I: General Knowledge; other papers as per Appendix I

exam_pattern.details: 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer Multiple-choice questions, each carrying 1 mark Written exam held at centres in 33 zones of the State Provisional answer key uploaded after the exam for online objections

how_to_apply: Apply online through the proforma application form on https://www.opsc.gov.in.
Registration and online application link open from 09.11.2026 to 30.11.2026 till 05.00 PM.
Submit only one online application; multiple applications through multiple PPSAN accounts will be rejected.
Pay Rs. 700 examination fee online while filling the form (SC, ST and PWD exempted).
Upload the required certificates (SEBC, PwD, Sports, Ex-Servicemen) where reservation is claimed.
Furnish bank account details for refund in the online application form.
important_instructions: Fee refunded only to candidates who actually appear in the Written Examination, to the original payment mode Number of vacancies is subject to change by the Government without notice Unfilled women vacancies go to male candidates of the same category No exchange of reservation between SC and ST Odisha Conduct of Examination Act, 1988 and Odisha Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024 apply LSC marks and individual marks declared on website only after Final Result and Select List

content_sections.heading: OPSC Assistant Section Officer (Group-B) Recruitment 2026 - Overview

rows.odisha_public_service_commission_opsc_ka: Rs. 35,400 in Level-9, Cell-1 of the ORSP Rules, 2017 Pay Matrix, plus DA and other allowances
Odisha Secretariat Service Cadre under Home Department, Government of Odisha

Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or equivalent, with adequate knowledge in Computer Application as specified in the Schedule. Candidates must also be able to speak, read and write Odia and meet the prescribed Odia qualification.
Must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years (as on 1 January 2026)

content_sections.heading: OPSC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 15 OF 2026-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download OPSC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or such other qualification equivalent thereto; Adequate knowledge in Computer Application as specified in the Schedule; Ability to speak, read and write Odia, with one of the prescribed Odia qualifications Age limit: Must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: SEBC 5 years, SC 5 years, ST 5 years, Women 5 years, Ex-Servicemen 5 years, PwD (40% or more) 10 years, PwD of SEBC/SC/ST 15 years (cumulative) Other conditions: Must be able to speak, read and write Odia with one of the prescribed Odia qualifications Adequate knowledge in Computer Application as specified in the Schedule Transgender candidates can apply Date of birth in the High School Certificate or equivalent only is accepted

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for OPSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Children of Ex-servicemen cannot apply against Ex-servicemen vacancies SEBC certificates issued before 10.11.2023 not considered under SEBC OBC certificate in place of SEBC certificate not considered against SEBC vacancies Ex-Servicemen already in regular State Government civil employment get no reservation, only age relaxation

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online mode while filling the Online Application Form.

rows.category: Candidates other than SC, ST and PWD

rows.event: Last Date for Online Application and Fee (05:00 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will OPSC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written Examination (Objective, MCQ) - 400 marks Skill Test in Computer (Practical, qualifying) - 50 marks Written exam: three papers, 400 marks, MCQ, one mark per question Minimum qualifying marks in each paper: UR/SEBC 35%, SC/ST 30%, PWD 28% Shortlisting for Skill Test about 1.5 times vacancies (more than 5 vacancies) or 2 times (5 or less, minimum 5) Computer Skill Test qualifying; at least 40% needed Final ranking on aggregate written marks out of 400; tie broken by Paper-I General Knowledge marks, then age

content_sections.heading: OPSC Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer Multiple-choice questions, each carrying 1 mark Written exam held at centres in 33 zones of the State Provisional answer key uploaded after the exam for online objections

rows.part_paper: Written Examination (Paper I, II and III)
rows.subject: Paper I: General Knowledge; other papers as per Appendix I

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: SEBC Caste Certificate issued on or after 10.11.2023 (SEBC candidates) Permanent Disability Certificate (PwD candidates) Sports Identity Card/Certificate issued by the Director of Sports, Odisha (Sports Persons) Ex-servicemen certificate (Ex-Servicemen) Odia pass certificate where Odia was not passed in HSC/Matriculation Bank account details: Account Number, IFSC, account holder name, bank branch

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for OPSC Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online through the proforma application form on https://www.opsc.gov.in. Registration and online application link open from 09.11.2026 to 30.11.2026 till 05.00 PM. Submit only one online application; multiple applications through multiple PPSAN accounts will be rejected. Pay Rs. 700 examination fee online while filling the form (SC, ST and PWD exempted). Upload the required certificates (SEBC, PwD, Sports, Ex-Servicemen) where reservation is claimed. Furnish bank account details for refund in the online application form.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Fee refunded only to candidates who actually appear in the Written Examination, to the original payment mode Number of vacancies is subject to change by the Government without notice Unfilled women vacancies go to male candidates of the same category No exchange of reservation between SC and ST Odisha Conduct of Examination Act, 1988 and Odisha Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024 apply LSC marks and individual marks declared on website only after Final Result and Select List

content_sections.heading: OPSC Assistant Section Officer (Group-B) Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026. Applications opened on 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 340 vacancies for Assistant Section Officer (Group-B).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates other than SC, ST and PWD: Rs. 700. SC, ST and PWD: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: SEBC 5 years, SC 5 years, ST 5 years, Women 5 years, Ex-Servicemen 5 years, PwD (40% or more) 10 years, PwD of SEBC/SC/ST 15 years (cumulative).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 35,400 in Level-9, Cell-1 of the ORSP Rules, 2017 Pay Matrix, plus DA and other allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or equivalent, with adequate knowledge in Computer Application as specified in the Schedule. Candidates must also be able to speak, read and write Odia and meet the prescribed Odia qualification.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be able to speak, read and write Odia with one of the prescribed Odia qualifications. Adequate knowledge in Computer Application as specified in the Schedule. Transgender candidates can apply. Date of birth in the High School Certificate or equivalent only is accepted.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Children of Ex-servicemen cannot apply against Ex-servicemen vacancies. SEBC certificates issued before 10.11.2023 not considered under SEBC. OBC certificate in place of SEBC certificate not considered against SEBC vacancies. Ex-Servicemen already in regular State Government civil employment get no reservation, only age relaxation.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Examination (Objective, MCQ) - 400 marks. Skill Test in Computer (Practical, qualifying) - 50 marks. Written exam: three papers, 400 marks, MCQ, one mark per question. Minimum qualifying marks in each paper: UR/SEBC 35%, SC/ST 30%, PWD 28%.
